title: Spy puts his back to the container wall, sidesteps to its corner, peeks round it, steps back and leaves

spawn.spot: yard south of container A, 100 uu from its south wall and 67 uu west of its south-east corner, facing the wall (+Y)
spawn.notes: Container A's south wall (under LG 104) rises 263.5 uu over the flat yard floor z -1143.5; a standing spy stops 36 uu from the lip line (y 250). The wall ends at the outside corner x -1632.6 (LG 104 meets LG 102). With his back to the wall the spy faces -Y; the view still looks +Y, and the left key then gives iMove 2 (Right), which the BTW move turns into a sidestep toward +X, the corner (measured in the first trial). Found with re/tools/difftest/gespots.py (btw).

inputs.note: stop at the wall (the stick must be inside 5000)
back-to-wall key, one frame: wall in front, enter back
left key: iMove 2 (the camera faces the spy, so the native swaps left and right), sidestep +X toward the corner, then peek round it
let go: back to the wall
back-to-wall key again: leave the wall
